component.name: Gridstead
component.summary: Infinite procedural wilderness survival, farming, and homestead RPG

description.p: Gridstead is an infinite procedural 2D wilderness survival, farming, and homestead RPG. Explore diverse biomes, gather resources, farm crops, craft tools and equipment, and survive hostile creatures and environmental threats.
Features include dynamic lighting and day/night cycles, seasonal farming, homestead building, crafting progression, underground exploration, and full gamepad and keyboard/mouse support.

screenshot.caption: Overworld exploration, farming, and wilderness survival

description.p: Initial Linux desktop release with standalone native runtime, custom controls, and dedicated GPU offloading.
